 Hayley Williams announces 2027 Asia tour with stops in Manila, Singapore, Seoul & Tokyo
 SPINS 
 2.4K 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 Photography by Elise Joseph James 
 First published: 13 November 2026 
 Last updated: 13 November 2026 
 News 
 Gigs 
 Events 
 Hayley Williams is bringing her solo show to Asia in 2027! The Paramore frontwoman has revealed four upcoming concerts in Manila, Singapore, Seoul, and Tokyo as part of her ongoing The Hayley Williams Show tour.
 The dates were unveiled through a livestream on Williams' official YouTube channel, featuring an animated visual of Tokyo's famous Shibuya Crossing. As her song ‘Dream Girl in Shibuya’ played, a digital billboard displayed the four Asian destinations and their respective concert dates.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by WE ARE PARAMORE (@weare_paramore) 
 The announced dates for The Hayley Williams Show in Asia are:
 24 February 2027 – Manila, Philippines 
 26 February 2027 – Singapore 
 1 March 2027 – Seoul, South Korea 
 3 March 2027 – Tokyo, Japan 
 The upcoming shows will spotlight Williams' solo career, bringing material from her three studio albums, Petals for Armor (2020), FLOWERS for VASES / descansos (2021), and Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party (2025), to fans across the region.
 While best known as the powerful voice behind Paramore, Williams has spent recent years establishing a distinctive musical identity outside the band, exploring alternative rock, indie pop, and more intimate, experimental sounds through her solo releases.
 Her latest album, Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party , marks another chapter in that evolution, featuring tracks such as ‘Mirtazapine’ , ‘Glum’ , ‘True Believer’ , and ‘Dream Girl in Shibuya’. The latter also received an official music video on 7 November, coinciding with the Asian tour announcement.
 The tour has also seen Williams embrace a more unpredictable live format, with performances drawing from her solo catalogue and occasional surprise collaborations. Previous concerts have featured appearances by Rico Nasty and Zedd , offering fans a different experience from her performances with Paramore.
 The 2027 Asian dates join an extensive international touring schedule spanning North America, Latin America, Australia, New Zealand, and Europe, as Williams continues bringing her solo music to audiences around the world.
 Venues, ticket prices, and ticket sale dates for the four Asian concerts have yet to be announced. However, fans can register through the official Asia tour sign-up page to receive updates about upcoming announcements and presales. Further details are expected to be announced through Hayley Williams' official website and social media channels.
